question.text: The bottom-up approach to stock selection:

answer.text: Evaluates a company's financial prospects first and fits it to the Investment Objective

explanation.text: The Logic: Bottom-up begins at the company level and builds the portfolio based on fit. The Trap: Top-down uses macro first; technical uses charts. Cross-Exam Context: Same framing in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Bottom-up works best in stock-picker PMS IAs; document stock rationale per IPS.
